attributes.probed_form: Selector matrix: replace `s32 t = *(s16*)(obj + 0x5c);` by s16/int/s32, combined initializer or `TYPE t; t = *(s16*)(obj + 0x5c);`; member variants use `MBObject* obj = (MBObject*)objv; TYPE t = obj->texchangeidx;` and `obj->texaltidx`, or selector-only `TYPE t = ((MBObject*)objv)->texchangeidx;` with the existing mbobject.h included. Flag controls: `TYPE f = *flags;` before/after selector followed by `f &= ~0x00080000; *flags = f;`, and `TYPE f = *flags & ~0x00080000; ... *flags = f;`, TYPE u32/unsigned int. Explicit forms `*flags = *flags & ~0x00080000;`, `*flags &= 0xFFF7FFFF;`, `*flags &= ~0x00080000U;`, `*flags = (int)*flags & ~0x00080000;`. Flag-view variants use `int* flagp = (int*)flags;` or unsigned int* with all flag writes through flagp, raw and member selector forms. Joint controls: s16/s32 member-selector with unmasked flag-local before selector or masked flag-local after selector. Case-source orders: all24 permutations of original case blocks [-1,-2,-4,-3], original default last and result arithmetic unchanged. Direct-member switch removes t cache and compares obj->texchangeidx again in default. If-chain controls use equality arms [-1,-2,-4,-3], [-2,-1,-4,-3], [-4,-3,-2,-1], preserving case actions then the original lo==t/default pack. Final store control places the same clear at entry of all five case/default arms, splitting local initializers where necessary so clear still precedes any potentially aliased texaltidx read. No production edit installed.
